model_lineage: applications/sensor_replay/audio_v1/run_audio_study.py: standardized per-channel squared distances, additive subset mean, nearest training-reference label; eight-channel/two-class adaptation.

erasure_1.empty_residual_rule: Panels with at most f channels fail an f-erasure requirement, even if every numerical threshold equals zero.
erasure_1.greedy_rule: Extension minimizes sum of positive exact constraint deficits across every required erasure survivor, then minimizes integer mask; stop at first feasible panel or all eight channels.
erasure_1.pruning_rule: Exact minimum-cardinality then minimum-integer-mask feasible subset of the final greedy panel, even when that panel is infeasible; feasibility is nonmonotone.
